notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP fetch (curl_cffi, impersonate=chrome124) worked cleanly - homepage and all category pages returned 200, no Akamai/Cloudflare block encountered, no browser tiers needed. robots.txt checked first: no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web disallow present, only faceted-nav/parameter disallows - tier (a) fully permitted. TREE: site is Next.js App Router (RSC streaming, no __NEXT_DATA__); category tree built from the 'Home & tech' mega-menu on the homepage (all top-level Home nodes: Kitchen, Candles & home fragrance, Dining, Home accessories, Outdoors, Bedroom, Pet accessories, Lighting, Furniture, Coffee table books, Stationery, Bathroom, Household electrical, Laundry & cleaning), then each relevant node's own 'categories' GraphQL facet (embedded in the self.__next_f RSC payload) was read to get exact child subcategories, each confirmed against its own breadcrumb/heading. QTY: qty = the 'count' field of the matching entry inside the page's own categories facet (evidence cites this); this facet's counts were cross-checked against the page's own pagination.total (e.g. Bedroom: 132+113+96+37+30+25+2=435 vs pagination total 435, exact match) confirming the numbers are the site's real per-node counts, not estimates. EXCLUDED: Furniture, Lighting, Coffee table books, Stationery, Household electrical, Candles & home fragrance, Pet accessories (266, all dog/cat products - pet boundary), Home accessories>Decorative accessories/Vases/Ornaments/Photo frames/Mirrors/Clocks/Candle holders/Wall art (decorative boundary, no storage subcategory beneath), Outdoors>Picnicware/Gardening/Beach accessories/Outdoor cooking (no textile or storage items), Outdoors>Garden furniture (29 items, predominantly furniture+lighting with 3 incidental storage-basket products mixed in but no distinct sub-URL to isolate them - excluded as mixed/no clean split), Bathroom>Bathroom accessories (48, mixed toothbrush holders/bins/soap dishes/some shower curtains with no distinct sub-URL - excluded as mixed), Bathroom>Bathroom mirrors (fixture, excluded), Dining>Napkins & rings (31, mixed cloth napkins + metal/silver napkin rings/holders, no distinct sub-URL to isolate cloth napkins - excluded as mixed), Dining>Placemats & coasters (167, mixed cotton/woven placemats with resin/leather/aluminium coasters, no distinct sub-URL - excluded as mixed), Dining>Glassware/Teacups & mugs/Plates/Bowls/Serveware/Cutlery/Bar accessories/Dining sets/Salt & pepper/Jugs/Teapots/Cakestands (kitchen & dining boundary), Laundry & cleaning (52, single leaf category mixing laundry baskets with cleaning sponges/detergents/bins/ironing boards/toilet brushes, no categories-facet subdivision exists to isolate just the storage items - excluded whole node as mixed, no clean split), Kitchen>Food storage>Travel cups and Water bottles (personal drinkware, not organizational storage - kitchen & dining boundary, only Lunchboxes & containers kept as genuine food-storage). No duplicate URLs recorded twice.
